body: Create original game production artwork for Betony 2021, a fictional badge-free salvage car in year 2994 clearly shaped like a 2021 Polestar 2 five-door electric fastback, original pre-facelift dark gridded front panel, upright angular fastback body, raised black wheel arch cladding, T-shaped white front light shapes and angular C-ended continuous red rear lightbar. Weathered deep teal paint with ivory roof and repaired graphite panels, restrained rust. No logos, brands, badges, letters or text. TRANSPARENT background. Exact 4 columns by 2 rows evenly spaced sprite atlas, all cars fully within their own cells, generous margins, orthographic near-horizontal views, consistent car, no shadows. Top row from left: straight FRONT, FRONT LEFT three-quarter (nose points RIGHT), LEFT side (nose RIGHT), REAR LEFT three-quarter (nose RIGHT). Bottom row: straight REAR, REAR RIGHT three-quarter (nose LEFT), RIGHT side (nose LEFT), FRONT RIGHT three-quarter (nose LEFT). IMPORTANT all wheels and tires entirely absent: clean transparent open wheel wells for separately animated wheels; no black circles in wells. Pixel-crisp detailed painterly realistic sprites, game scale, no scenery or labels. Wide 2:1 canvas.
spacingEdit: Edit this exact eight-car transparent sprite atlas. Preserve the eight designs and camera directions without any mirroring, keep all wheels absent and wheel wells transparent. Fix cell spacing: canvas is exactly four equal columns and two equal rows. Each car must be entirely contained inside its own rectangular cell with at least 30 pixels empty margin on left and right. There must be no pixels crossing a column boundary. Shrink each sprite uniformly to fit, center each within its own cell. Top row centers at12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% ofwidth and25% height. Bottom row same Xcenters75%height. Remove yellow/white alpha-edge fringing above roofs; no shadows, no new objects or markings. Transparent background. Keep original crisp detailed teal/ivory weathered artwork and fully open wheel wells.
alphaCleanup: Remove the entire noisy gray/yellow background from this image. Return exactly the eight teal-and-ivory car cutouts, same positions, same sizes, same angles, on perfectly transparent background. Remove every background pixel outside car silhouettes and inside wheel openings. DO NOT add background textures, shadows, smoke or checkerboards. Clean transparent alpha edges. Preserve cars and empty wheel wells with no wheels.
dashboard: Original game cockpit overlay art, vehicle Betony 2021 inspired by 2021 Polestar 2 UK RIGHT HAND DRIVE electric fastback. Year2994 salvage weathered charcoal textile and black matte synthetic trim with dull teal repaired dash. Wide3:1 horizontal canvas. Straight ahead seated driver view across full cabin, dashboard occupies bottom HALF of image, transparent windshield upper half, narrow A pillars at edges. Instrument binnacle on RIGHT with wide rectangular blank black digital display, portrait rectangular blank dark center tablet at horizontal center, slim vents, minimal modern dashboard. Right steering column hub near lower right, NO steering wheel (separate animated game overlay). NO gauges, numbers, text, icons, logos or badges anywhere. Large blank digital instrument panel around x75percent,y65percent to fit live speed/kW/battery. Dashboard extends to bottom edge, center console. No external scene, no roof, no seats, no rendered reflections above dashboard. Pixel crisp detailed painterly game artwork, subdued edges, physically recognizable modern angular minimalist EV dash; no copied photograph.
